items.title: Local silent webcam dictation plugin
items.oneliner: Mac plugin turns lip movements into text locally, giving you silent prompting without recording audio or sending video.

items.title: Rust paint app tutorial
items.oneliner: Twelve-chapter Rust tutorial builds a paint app from scratch and teaches rasterization through about 800 lines of code.

items.title: Retro gamedev Linux distro
items.oneliner: Minimal Linux distro for retro gamedev ships SDL3 and cross-platform tooling in under 100MB RAM and 600MB disk.

items.title: VS Code support for design docs
items.oneliner: VS Code extension adds linting, autocomplete, and preview for design.md files so design system docs become editable like code.

items.title: Modern Go tooling guide
items.oneliner: Hands-on Go tooling guide covers install, debug, test, security, and live reload with current commands you can use today.

items.title: Stable self-hosted mail CLI suite
items.oneliner: Pimalaya's stable CLI suite unifies email, contacts, and calendar tools under shared configs for scriptable self-hosted workflows.

items.title: Rust library for WinHelp files
items.oneliner: Deep reverse-engineering walkthrough explains WinHelp internals and ships a Rust library for reading legacy .hlp archives.

items.title: AT and T Unix PC VM
items.oneliner: Prebuilt AT&T Unix PC virtual machine bundles TCP/IP and apps so retro Unix developers can boot and explore immediately.

items.title: Practical guide to self-hosted email
items.oneliner: Case study on reclaiming email shows how organizations self-host with open standards instead of depending on Google or Microsoft.

items.title: Object storage admin UI release
items.oneliner: Garage v2.6.0 adds a web admin UI for managing S3-compatible clusters, buckets, and monitoring without custom scripts.
